elaine (docs): Quick flag: the /v1/rerank API ref still uses a single-string `queries` example. We deprecated auto-wrap; example needs to show an array of query objects. Opening small PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3201
matt (eng): Confirmed. Runtime requires `queries: [{query: string, top_k?: number}]`. Please show only the array-of-objects form.
nina (sdk): I'll update the JS/TS snippets after the docs change. Current SDK types permit legacy shapes; planning a patch to narrow to the object-array and add a migration note.
jordan (api): Add a migration callout in the docs: "Previously accepted single-string queries are deprecated; send an array of query objects. Results are matched to queries via `query_index`." Also mention `documents` can be strings or objects (e.g., {id, text}).
matt (eng): Quick corrected curl payload you can drop in:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"rerank-large-v1","queries":[{"query":"Where is tokenization documented?","top_k":5},{"query":"How to set up Dedicated capacity?","top_k":3}],"documents":["Doc A text","Doc B text","Doc C text"]}'
```
matt (eng): Example response (abridged): `{"results":[{"query_index":0,"document_indices":[0,2],"scores":[0.97,0.65]},{"query_index":1,"document_indices":[2,0],"scores":[0.88,0.40]}]}`

nina (sdk): Thanks — I'll link SDK PR to docs PR 3201 and include a migration note in the changelog.
ci-bot: docs build for PR 3201 passed  https://ci.redwood.ai/3201/builds/3
elaine (docs): Patch applied: curl + response + migration callout and a short note about per-doc metadata. Merging after one proofread. Thanks!"
